Meir Orbach / CTech :

 Bites, whose AI tools deliver personalized training to frontline workers via WhatsApp, SMS, Slack, and other channels, raised a $40M Series A led by PeakSpan   —  The platform turns company procedures into short, branded videos delivered through WhatsApp, Teams and other familiar channels.
